root_cause: The OpenVINO conversion of the GPTQ-quantized OPT-125M model (katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq) produces inference results that differ from the original PyTorch model beyond the acceptance threshold. The max diff is ~0.069 in the logits tensor. This is a recurring regression first seen on 2026-07-27 (pattern count now 21) that blocks numerous unrelated PRs in the merge queue. The root cause is likely a numerical precision issue introduced in the GPTQ 4-bit quantization path of the PyTorch frontend or CPU plugin.
reproduction_steps: Run: pytest install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_llm.py::TestLLMModel::test_export_model_precommit[CPU-opt_gptq-katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq] -v on Linux with PyTorch 2.12+cpu and the installed OpenVINO build from the merge-queue SHA.
recommended_actions: Investigate and fix the accuracy regression in GPTQ 4-bit quantized model conversion (PyTorch FX frontend or CPU plugin) that causes the OPT-125M GPTQ test to fail with max diff ~0.069.
Consider temporarily adding katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq to the skip list to unblock the merge queue while the root cause is investigated.
Review recent changes to the PyTorch frontend GPTQ handling between 2026-07-26 and now to identify the breaking change.
prevention_strategies: Add a precommit accuracy gate for GPTQ quantized models so regressions are caught before entering the merge queue. Consider a dedicated nightly test that tracks max diff over time and alerts on regressions.
historical_context: This is the 21st occurrence of this pattern (signature_hash 671a331e9a60933e), first seen 2026-07-27. It has been blocking merge-queue PRs continuously since then.
